verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory filing fees is a fair question for a Secretary of State business-filing office, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any fee amounts. The Gateway and tax items cover logins, OHID, tax tools and outreach, not filing fees. The SOS site and the Business Central filing portal both returned 403 at robots.txt, so none of their pages were read. Confidence is low because the lack of evidence may come from that access wall rather than from the fees being unpublished.
